stage_1a_apple_detector_yolov8n.justification: YOLO annotations are 100% verified, coordinates normalized, and 80 visual previews certified. Restriction: Apple dataset is CC BY-NC 4.0 (academic/experimental prototype only). Training image paths in data.yaml need resolution during Phase 16B training launch.

stage_1_fruit_identifier_resnet18_v2.justification: Multi-source diversity achieved for Guava, Banana, Apple, and Negatives. Zero split leakage. Zero group crossing. Ready for experimental training in Phase 16B to benchmark against flawed Phase 15C baseline.

stage_2_guava_classifier.justification: Active production model (best_guava_resnet18.pth) is fully validated. Retraining unnecessary until Stage 1 gating is certified.

stage_2_banana_classifier.justification: Model trained in Phase 14E (best_banana_resnet18.pth) and integration tested in Phase 14F. Remains gated in model_registry.py awaiting Stage 1 gate.

stage_2_apple_classifier.justification: Stage 2 Apple ripeness model not yet trained. Blocked by CC BY-NC 4.0 commercial restriction.

stage_2_mango_classifier.justification: Extreme data deficit: only 272 physical images across 4 ripeness classes (65 per class) from a single farm session. High risk of severe overfitting. Mango remains strictly blocked from production.
